name: Real-time power position hand-off and Enpower/CAPS deal entry
description: On the Portland real-time desk, Bill Williams, prescheduling and the cash desks email the shift whenever the book is short or long. Each email gives MW, hours, hub, price, book and deal numbers, along with instructions for El Paso Electric lending days and EOL trades. Shift traders and support re-key these into Enpower, CAPS and the position sheets, following entry rules that are restated by email. Mismatches between the emailed positions and Enpower are clarified by further emails.
stall_points: Instructions are sent piecemeal and re-forwarded as more trades are made. The same shorts and deal numbers are re-sent day after day. Price and counterparty details are deferred to 'check with' other traders. Emailed positions carry wrong hours, delivery points or deal numbers. Lending prices and deal numbers are re-keyed per day and corrected afterwards, and EOL deals go missing in Enpower.
automation: Generate the shift position summary directly from the position manager and the Enpower deals. Templated deal sets (for example EPE lending) and EOL trades would be auto-created in Enpower with book and strip defaults, and validated against desk rules. A daily match of broker and EOL deals against Enpower would flag gaps, replacing free-text position emails and manual re-keying.
